thread:
chao: heads-up — saw a sharp rise in 429s from clients hitting us in eu-west-2 around 14:03 UTC. logs show queueing spikes on the edge gateways and a pattern of clients retrying immediately. :warning:

infra-bot: Alert: region-eu-west-2 GPU pool utilization 96% (sustained 5m), queue length 68, inflight requests 420.

alice: thanks. are the 429s coming with any headers? I want to see if we can communicate a granular backpressure surface to SDKs.

chao: yes — current gateway returns standard 429 with Retry-After sometimes, but inconsistent. I sketched a small header proposal in the logs: X-RW-Queue-Length, X-RW-Capacity-Pct, X-RW-Estimate-Requeue-ms. sample: `X-RW-Queue-Length: 68`, `X-RW-Capacity-Pct: 4`, `Retry-After: 3`

ben: nit: keep Retry-After for RFC compatibility but add a machine-readable delta, e.g. `X-RW-Suggested-Backoff: 4500` (ms). clients can jitter around it. Also include `X-RW-Region-Token` that encodes whether the error is regional-only vs global.

diane: from SDK POV we need a deterministic algorithm: backoff = max(Retry-After, X-RW-Suggested-Backoff) * jitterFactor. also need per-route token buckets so chat vs embed workloads don't starve each other. I'll prototype.

chao: two extra asks: 1) mark 429s that are admission-control vs over-quota (different retry semantics). maybe `X-RW-429-Reason: admission|quota|rate` 2) don't let clients flood fallback region automatically — that's how we saw cascade to eu-central as it got overwhelmed. we prefer clients to consult a small region-fallback policy.

alice: agree. For admission 429s we should recommend immediate soft-fail (reduce batch or reroute to cheaper model) rather than aggressive retry. For quota 429s, keep normal exponential backoff. Recommend SDK exposes handler hooks for each reason.

ben: putting a short pseudocode snippet for SDK implementers:
```
// on 429 response
backoffMs = max(parseHeader("Retry-After")*1000 || 0, parseHeader("X-RW-Suggested-Backoff") || 0)
backoffMs *= random(0.8, 1.2) // jitter
if (header("X-RW-429-Reason") == "admission") {
  // reduce concurrency, shrink batch size
  client.adjustConcurrency(-1)
  backoffMs = Math.max(backoffMs, 2000)
}
await sleep(backoffMs)
```

chao: perfect. Also add a header that exposes remaining admission window tokens so clients can slow down preemptively: `X-RW-Window-Tokens: 12` (int).

diane: SDK should treat Window-Tokens like a credit: if tokens < threshold, delay requests and prefer smaller batch. We'll add a token-aware queue in the next SDK release.

alice: question about security/abuse — don't want clients to game Window-Tokens by spinning more clients. Maybe make tokens scoped to admission-token which is per API key and region. `X-RW-Admission-Token: abc123.sig`

chao: yes — token should be cryptographically bound to key+region+short-ttl. We can issue tokens at gateway and rotate. If token missing, clients get admission-only 429s and generic backoff.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: edge-gateway patch v2.11 -> added X-RW-* headers for eu-west-2 (canary).

ben: operational note: we need to mark these headers in docs and set expectations: not all 429s will include all headers, and values are best-effort.

alice: also add observability: record when SDK honors suggested backoff vs when it ignores it, so we can see client compliance and tune windows.

chao: short-term mitigation: enable admission-shedder to start rejecting non-priority jobs (batch cheaper models) in eu-west-2 for 10m and set global routing to avoid auto-failover from eu-west-2 to eu-central. I'll open a followup PR to the routing policy.

diane: I'll queue an SDK issue and a changelog entry. patching default retry jitter to +/-30% for admission 429s.

chao: thanks all. keep eyes on alerts for next 20m. if we still see cascading retries we'll throttle client error budgets at the edge. :thumbsup:
